gaps.sentence: ___ unemployment has fallen sharply this year.
gaps.explanation: Unemployment as a general concept takes no article.
Plural general nouns and flu (illness name) take no article.

gaps.sentence: ___ noise woke me up in the middle of the night.
gaps.explanation: 'The noise' — the one that woke me; 'in the night' is a fixed phrase.

gaps.sentence: She has ___ excellent command of Japanese.
gaps.explanation: 'Have an excellent command of' — 'excellent' starts with a vowel sound.

gaps.sentence: She earns her living as ___ journalist.
gaps.explanation: Jobs after 'as' take a/an: as a journalist.

gaps.sentence: We reached ___ agreement after hours of negotiation.
gaps.explanation: 'Reach an agreement' — 'agreement' starts with a vowel sound.

gaps.sentence: ___ United Kingdom consists of four countries.
gaps.explanation: 'The United Kingdom', 'the USA', 'the Czech Republic' all take 'the'.

gaps.sentence: The patient needs ___ operation as soon as possible.
gaps.explanation: 'An operation' — 'operation' starts with a vowel sound.
